articles.title: OTA Firmware Updates for Vehicle Fleets: Staging, Rollback and What to Ask Vendors
articles.excerpt: If you run dozens or hundreds of tablets bolted into trucks and tractors, updating firmware by visiting each vehicle with a cable and a laptop does not scale. Over-the-air (OTA) updates replace that w…
articles.body: If you run dozens or hundreds of tablets bolted into trucks and tractors, updating firmware by visiting each vehicle with a cable and a laptop does not scale. Over-the-air (OTA) updates replace that with a remote push over cellular or Wi-Fi. This post covers what "an update" actually means, how to stage one, and what to ask a vendor. Three kinds of update, three levels of risk "OTA update" gets used for three different things: Application updates : a new version of the dispatch or fleet app. Lowest risk, most frequent. Configuration changes : settings, kiosk lock-down, allowed apps. Changed from the console, no new build needed. Firmware and OS updates : the layer under everything else. Highest risk, so this is the one that needs staging and a rollback plan.
articles.author: CF-Device

articles.body: OpenAI LifeVal Nedir? Günlük Görev Benchmark'ı OpenAI LifeVal, bir çocuğu okula kaydettirmek, ev bütçesini yönetmek veya bir devlet dairesiyle işleri halletmek gibi günlük yaşam görevlerinden oluşan 169 görevlik bir kıyaslama setidir; bir yapay zekâ ajanı bu görevleri tarayıcı kullanımı, bilgisayar kullanımı ve bağlayıcılar aracılığıyla tamamlar. Her deneme bir rubrikle puanlanır ve puan, 0 ile 1 arasındaki ortalama ödüldür. GPT-6 Astra, xhigh efor düzeyinde %80,6 puan alır. Apidog'u bugün deneyin Kısa versiyonu bu. Aşağıda OpenAI'nin LifeVal'i nasıl oluşturduğunu, yayımladığı her model puanını (yalnızca sayfanın etkileşimli grafiğinde bulunan efor bazlı sayılar dahil), bu sayıların akıl yürütme eforu hakkında ne söylediğini ve kıyaslamanın neleri dışarıda bıraktığını bulacaksınız.

articles.title: DiscImageStudio: así se dibuja en la cara de un disco
articles.excerpt: Un CD, un DVD o un Blu-ray puede llevar una imagen visible en discos que se nota a simple vista sobre la cara grabada, sin necesidad de ningún lector especial para verla. Eso es lo que genera DiscImag…
articles.body: Un CD, un DVD o un Blu-ray puede llevar una imagen visible en discos que se nota a simple vista sobre la cara grabada, sin necesidad de ningún lector especial para verla. Eso es lo que genera DiscImageStudio, el proyecto de código abierto publicado en GitHub por JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat: convierte cualquier fotografía en el patrón físico de bits de un CD, un DVD o un Blu-ray BD-R, listo para grabarse en un disco real. Tiene una app de escritorio para Windows con editor visual completo, y una CLI experimental para Linux y macOS que genera los mismos ISO, WAV o RAW desde la terminal, con el mismo motor de generación física por dentro. TL;DR DiscImageStudio convierte una imagen en datos físicos de CD, DVD o Blu-ray BD-R que se ven al grabarse en un disco real.

articles.excerpt: ¿Qué es OpenAI LifeVal? El benchmark de tareas cotidianas OpenAI LifeVal es un benchmark de 169 tareas de la vida cotidiana, como matricular a un hijo en la escuela, gestionar el presupuesto de un hog…
articles.body: ¿Qué es OpenAI LifeVal? El benchmark de tareas cotidianas OpenAI LifeVal es un benchmark de 169 tareas de la vida cotidiana, como matricular a un hijo en la escuela, gestionar el presupuesto de un hogar o tratar con una oficina gubernamental, que un agente de IA completa con uso del navegador, uso del ordenador y conectores. Una rúbrica puntúa cada intento, y la puntuación es la recompensa media de 0 a 1. GPT-6 Astra obtiene un 80,6% con esfuerzo xhigh. Prueba Apidog hoy Esa es la versión corta.

articles.body: 6 Min Read Happy 65 Years: NASA’s Johnson Space Center Then and Now View of the Manned Spacecraft Center during construction in 1963. Sixty-five years ago, a bold vision took root in Houston: a NASA center dedicated to human spaceflight. Since its founding, NASA’s Johnson Space Center has helped lead the nation’s human spaceflight program, supporting missions from Project Mercury through Artemis. Today, Johnson serves as NASA’s Center of Excellence for Human Spaceflight, and its workforce is helping to usher in a Golden Age of innovation and discovery. Johnson is home to America’s astronaut corps, the Mission Control Center, and the teams behind some of humanity’s greatest achievements in space.

articles.title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
articles.excerpt: In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automa…
articles.body: In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automating entire workflows and taking actions based on agent insights. But there is a problem: The quality of insights that agents currently generate leaves much to be desired. Fewer than half of agent-generated insights at the organizations surveyed for this report lead to business improvement. And while most respondents praise the quality of their agents’ descriptive insights, reviews of their prescriptive insights—those on which actions are based—are decidedly mixed.
